description:
[read-only] The Schedule → Failed backlog of the brand: one row per platform of a post that did not go out, with its row `id`, postId, contentId, account, slot, lastError, reasonClass and `coverage` ("live" / "rebooked" when the platform is now covered elsewhere, null when nothing known covers it). Filters: state (open = what the tab shows, the default), platform, zernioAccountId, reasonClass, slotAfter / slotBefore. Follow `cursor` until it is null; a page can be short. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"list_failed"}.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/failed.)

brandId.description: Format: string; e.g. "brandId_123". Brand identifier from list_brands; use a real ID.

cursor.description: Opaque string, e.g. "eyJvIjoyMH0". The `nextCursor` of the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fields.description: String array, e.g. ["id", "title"]. Top-level item fields to return instead of the summary. Default: a summary of each item's plain fields.

limit.description: Integer, e.g. 20. Items per page (1-50, default 20).

platform.description: Format: string; e.g. "instagram". Social platform identifier.

reasonClass.description: Format: string; e.g. "auth_or_account". Failure category to filter.

slotBefore.description: Format: ISO 8601 with timezone; e.g. "2026-11-20T12:00:00-06:00". Only rows whose slot is before this instant.

state.description: Format: string; e.g. "open". Processing state to select.

zernioAccountId.description: Format: string; e.g. "zernioAccountId_123". Zernio connected account identifier.

name: list_failed
title: List the Failed tab
